entries.Ay, the Sceptre of Fire. The Sceptre has: Aye, the Sceptre of Fire. The Sceptre has a long, glorious, and fearful history. But I am not here to tell you how the jewel within it was brought over the ocean by Haldric the Great, nor will I tell the story of Garard I and the challenge he set, nor that of Konrad, King of Wesnoth by virtue of the Sceptre.
entries.Transport 5 caravans full of silver to t: Transport 5 caravans full of silver to the dwarvish stronghold in the north-east corner
entries.Transport 4 caravans full of silver to t: Transport 4 caravans full of silver to the dwarvish stronghold in the north-east corner
entries.Bring Alanin, who has the Ruby of Fire,: Bring Alanin, who has the Ruby of Fire, to the dwarvish stronghold in the north-east corner
entries.Moving a dwarf to a rune chest beside th: Moving a dwarf to a rune chest beside the keep opens a dialogue for obtaining temporary upgrades which last until the end of the scenario.
entries.And what... you want us to do this, cont: And what... you want us to do this, contain the radiance of the stone? By making an artefact of some kind?
entries.Exactly. I want you to craft it into a m: Exactly. I want you to craft it into a mighty artefact that will not only exploit the stone’s power, but contain it also.
entries.You said you wanted a powerful magical a: You said you wanted a powerful magical artefact, not a child’s play-toy! So... twenty thousand, minimum. The crafting of this will take us many years, you must pay us well.
entries.Very well. I have the silver here, ready: Very well. I have the silver here, ready to deliver, and I will send someone over with the stone itself. He will stay with you as you make the sceptre, and make sure you get it done on time. I expect it done before my reign as king is ended.
entries.We Wesnothians and you elves have a trea: We Wesnothians and you elves have a treaty! Do you really mean to break it in defence of a road that is not even yours?!
entries.Ah, I see — you are one of the rebels. O: Ah, I see — you are one of the rebels. Our treaty with the elves does not apply to you, so I have no problem with slaying you if you stand in our way. Rugnur, we will proceed with the delivery.
entries.Moving a dwarf to a rune chest north of: Moving a dwarf to a rune chest north of the keep opens a dialogue for obtaining temporary upgrades which last until the end of the scenario.
entries.These elves are right behind me! We have: These elves are right behind me! We have to go and warn the council of this attack...!
entries.Here — I’ll go warn the council. You sta: Here — I’ll go and warn the council. You stay here and fight.
entries.Och, well that’s the difficulty. It’s a: Och, well that’s the difficulty. It’s a magic gate. Indestructible. But that means it can only be closed by magic. Ye need to position a warrior on each of the six glyphs. When all are occupied, the gates wi’ close. Then the elves will be shut out of the caves for ever, at least through this entrance.
entries.Two are down a side passage in the north: Two are down a side passage in the north-west, another two are in a similar location in the south-east, and two are right next to the front gate.
entries.I think it can be sealed up somehow... y: I think it can be sealed somehow... yes, look, activating that glyph seems to have closed the gap.
entries.As the group got near the source of the: As the group got near the source of the glow, they heard metallic banging and guttural shouting, and their noses were assaulted by a foetid smell...
entries.We see you, we hear you, sneaky little m: We see you, we hear you, sneaky little moles! Pidmer, go and skewer them!
entries.What?! You already accepted? Foolish boy: What?! You already accepted? Foolish boy, you should have come for one of the elders! We could have got much more than ten thousand silver out of him! This is a task that will take many years, and now all of our work in that time will bring us very little gain.
entries.Well, since this boy bargained so badly,: Well, since this boy bargained so badly, why not make him fulfil the contract himself? If he fails, it’s on his head.
entries.A friend of Rugnur, huh? ... Follow him: A friend of Rugnur, huh...? Follow him north. He needs all the help he can get!
entries.His will probably be the only house up h: His will probably be the only house up here. No-one else is insane enough to live this far north! Even the elves won’t challenge us here.
entries.Krawg!\n<i>(Looks out over the icy taiga: Krawg! (Looks out over the icy taiga, turns gaze back towards the dwarves.)
entries.It is a Wesnothian gem, but it is also s: It is a Wesnothian gem, but it is also supposedly the most powerful magical artefact ever seen. Even an untrained hand can use it to cast fiery bolts as powerful as those of arch mages.
entries.Hrmph, so you need to deliver this power: Hrmph, so you need to deliver this power to the king, but also seek to contain that foolish man... I see your dilemma, and I do love a challenge, so let’s build this powerful artefact. I expect it will take years.
entries.If we want to make this work, we will ne: If we want to make this work, we will need every rune-blasted edge we can get. If I have some time to set up shop at a keep, I can prepare a little rune-craft for your troops. My goods do not come cheaply though, I will not stoop to trifling apprentice-work...
entries.The path back to the dwarven city was we: The path back to the dwarven city was well known to the travellers this time, so the journey south was relatively quick and uneventful. A week’s march brought the expedition to the familiar plaza, with two new members of their party — one expected, and one not.
entries.I would say probably ten stone of artifa: I would say probably ten stone of artefact-quality gold and twenty stone of the most dense and black of coal, and many of the clearest crystals in the land. I’ll also need to have the jeweller cut the ruby once I have the plans done.
entries.You try my patience, Durstorn. I need th: You try my patience, Durstorn. I need the highest quality materials, or I can’t make the sceptre! Are you telling me you have a treasury full of artefact-quality gold?
entries.For me to make the artifact Haldric want: For me to make the artefact Haldric wants, I need a special type of gold. I know not exactly where it can be found, but Baglur said these mines were the source of it.
Rugnur and his companions returned home. Now, I do not want to give the impression that only Rugnur and Thursagan worked on this masterpiece. There were others — many others. Thus I present Theganli, the jeweller. His role is small, but an important one.
entries.So, you have returned. I assume you have: So, you have returned. I assume you have obtained the required materials? My jeweller Theganli has spent great time and expense buying jewels from some of the northern clans. Now go to the forge and make your sceptre. What do you need to annoy me for?
entries.Another group of dwarves that live south: Another group of dwarves that live south of here... above ground, if you can believe it! Yes, they’re the best jewellers...
Fine! Go and rent it from them.
entries.Bah! Getting this cut isn’t worth that m: Bah! Getting this cut isn’t worth that much — with Rugnur’s mistake earlier, and all the other expenses. If we pay more than a thousand, we’ll barely even make a profit!
entries.I thought we left the elves behind at th: I thought we left the elves behind back at the gates... it seems we have two enemies now!
entries.And how do you plan on doing that? There: And how do you plan to do that? There are elves swarming these hills, trying to kill us.
entries.We have driven all of the elves and Shor: We have driven all of the elves and Shorbear dwarves out of these caves. They are not ours, though, and we can’t stay here for ever.
entries.Move Rugnur to the northeast cave entran: Move Rugnur to the north-east cave entrance
entries.What happened to your honor, Durstorn?!: What happened to your honour, Durstorn?!
entries.You little fool, honor is less important: You little fool, honour is less important than life! Open the gates, I’m going out to negotiate our safe passage out of here!
entries.Yes. See the area to the northeast of us: Yes. See the area to the north-east of us?
entries.Well, you are a member of the Wesnothian: Well, you are a member of the Wesnothian army. Why don’t you rejoin it? See if you can run past those elves to our south-east...
entries.Here, if you are still having doubts, le: Here, if you are still having doubts, let me inscribe this rune for you to help you slip past their defences.
entries.Alanin, ride south as fast as you can. T: Alanin, ride south as fast as you can. Tell Haldric we are heading north-east, towards the old eastern mines. And if he wants his precious sceptre, he should send forces to meet us there as soon as he can!
entries.Tell him to send forces north to aid us: Tell him to send forces north to aid us and fight the elves, but that we are probably going to die. We will run north-east towards the old eastern mines. And if he wants his sceptre intact, he’d best send troops to meet us there.
entries.Great, now there is no need to worry abo: Great, now there is no need to worry about those elves any more!
entries.Even though my chances have grown worse,: Even though my chances have grown worse, I have to fulfil my duty. I do not owe them any less!
entries.I see. Well, come on in. They could neve: I see. Well, come in. They could never capture this fort, even if they did want to start a war, which I doubt.
entries.An enemy moves onto the forge: An enemy moves on to the forge
entries.I am Khrakrahs, greatest dragon of all t: I am Khrakrahs, greatest dragon of all time! Haldric killed Shek’kahan, my brother, but he was weaker than me and you will not find me so easy to defeat. Now get out of my volcano!
entries.Haha, you’re making friends all over, yo: Ha ha, you’re making friends all over, you cowards!
entries.This forge will work perfectly. Give me: This forge will work perfectly. Give me a day or two here, and I can reforge the Sceptre of Fire to fulfil its purpose.
entries.I have completed my work. Now it is trul: I have completed my work. Now it is truly the Sceptre of Fire, a powerful magical artefact.
entries.Alright, there’s no turning back now!: All right, there’s no turning back now!
entries.Once the magic seal capping the throat o: Once the magic seal capping the throat of the volcano was removed, lava and toxic gas exploded upwards, killing everyone inside and sealing them in a tomb of hot, flowing rock. Krawg and the gryphon riders flew towards a hole in the roof but it was only Krawg who managed to out-fly the explosion and emerge as the sole survivor. The Sceptre of Fire would wait, unharmed by the lava, until some day far in the future.

Once the magic seal capping the throat of the volcano was removed, lava and toxic gas exploded upwards, killing everyone inside and sealing them in a tomb of hot, flowing rock. The Sceptre of Fire would wait, unharmed by the lava, until some day far in the future.
entries.Look up! If this were a normal volcano,: Look up! If this were a normal volcano, you’d see stars and sky. Instead, there’s a high ceiling, shaped like a cone. This means that something must be holding back the volcano’s lava flow. This thing, if it exists, could be our chance to trigger an eruption. The first place I would consider investigating would be the centre of this chamber.
entries.This must be the center of the volcano!: This must be the centre of the volcano! The lava is blocked just as you surmised, Thursagan! It’s plugged up with this... enchanted courtyard?
entries.Alanin traveled south to Wesnoth, to rep: Alanin travelled south to Wesnoth, to report the events of the past years to Haldric II.
entries.What!? Why? Do the dwarves not honor our: What!? Why? Do the dwarves not honour our contract? Has Rugnur, or whatever his name is, become a thief?
entries.No, that is my... friend Krawg. He went: No, that is my... friend Krawg. He went with Rugnur into the caves, but escaped through a hole in the roof just before the lava filled the cave.
entries.It’s difficult to accept, you are right,: It’s difficult to accept, you are right, my liege. However, I have fought side-by-side with the dwarves and this gryphon, and I stake my honour on the story. What’s more, the gryphon has some evidence. Show him, Krawg.
entries.Red Wyrms are strange beasts, stout serp: Red Wyrms are strange beasts, stout serpents with wings, but no legs. Their skin is red and rock-like, impervious to fire but more brittle than regular scales or any other lizard armour. They are relatively rare, and their presence is attributed to some eccentric wizard or dragon. Mature Wyrms have excellent control of their fire breath attack, as if they are themselves miniature dragons.
entries.As they are constructs of snow and ice,: As they are constructs of snow and ice, they can repair and regenerate when in a favourable environment. However, the icy regrowth seems prone to errors, so while they were likely formed in the image of ideal warriors, they have become misshapen and their movement thus compromised. This malformation is most obvious in their hand and arms, which take the most damage.
entries.Simple beings conjured up from ice and s: Simple beings conjured from ice and snow, Snow Imps fend for themselves by spitting globs of frozen sludge with surprising force. Even though they are slow, fragile, and vulnerable to fire, their resistance to a common citizen’s improvised blunt weaponry makes them a hazard to inexperienced wanderers of the frozen northern lands.
entries.Thursagan’s Rune Mastery: while Thursaga: Thursagan’s Rune Mastery: while Thursagan is on a keep, selecting an adjacent dwarf opens a dialogue for obtaining temporary upgrades which last until the end of the scenario.
